task_description: M08 robot DB: next-strike countdown, sound alert, JSON persistence (robots.json); Docker packaging

INTAKE.notes: M08 robot DB + Docker requested; must commit on working state.

DISCOVERY.notes: REST polling injects synthetic trades; trade_gaps = poll interval. CV threshold 0.25 unreliable for REST. Real fix: detect robots via VOLUME ANOMALY (last poll volume >= ROBOT_VOL_RATIO x recent avg, price barely moved), not tick-CV.

ARCHITECTURE.notes: M08.evaluate uses s.history window (6 polls) for volume-anomaly; RobotSession tracks detected/last/closed state; DB write throttled 30s; Windows sound via ctypes.

SOLUTION.notes: Implemented: trade_gaps tracking, M08 volume-anomaly detection, robots.json persistence, .env.example ROBOT_VOL_RATIO/ROBOT_PRICE_TOLERANCE.

IMPACT.notes: REST-safe robot detection; works with both REST and WebSocket modes; .gitignore excludes robot_db/; Docker file mounts robot_db volume.

SIMULATION.notes: Live test 14:35-14:37 MSK: 6 cycles REST mode, no crashes, no false signals (vol_ratio=1.3, price_tol=0.003).

IMPLEMENTATION.notes: Committed: d8b2c2e, 4cdedf8, ca8bd59. Docker packaging ready on host machine.
